name: OfficeRoad
role: visual meta office and AI workspace
definition: OfficeRoad is BlackRoad's visual meta office. OfficeRoad is where humans and AI teammates work side-by-side in a visible office-like space. It is not just a dashboard. It is a spatial work environment where tasks, documents, agents, rooms, desks, statuses, and collaboration can be seen and arranged. OfficeRoad should feel like a meta office, a visible AI workplace, a room where agents have desks, and a work environment instead of a pile of tabs where the user can see who/what is working on what. OfficeRoad should support visual office rooms, desks/workstations, AI teammate presence, human teammate presence, task cards, document surfaces, agent status, project rooms, and meeting spaces.
core_promise: See the office. See the work. See the agents.
